item.title: Former Crowley ISD teacher arrested, accused of improper relationship with student
item.description: A former Crowley ISD teacher is in jail and has been charged with having an improper relationship with a student.62-year-old Ricardo Ortiz was arrested Thursday, Feb. 5 by Fort Worth police. A letter from Crowley ISD says once it found out about the allegations, Ortiz was removed from contact with students and is no longer employed by the district.Ortiz previously served as a high school architecture teacher at the Bill R. item.title: North Richland Hills man federally indicted on alleged online threats towards ICE
item.description: A North Texas man has been federally indicted after posting violent threats online towards ICE and President Donald Trump.36-year-old Francisco Jesus Mena was indicted by a federal grand jury on Feb. 3. item.title: 2 injured in Balch Springs shooting, police say
item.description: Authorities in Balch Springs said two youths were injured after a shooting that led to a police chase Friday night.Balch Springs police said they were called to 4608 Pioneer Rd. just before 9 p.m. Friday for a shooting. item.title: Man charged with capital murder for shooting death of Dallas tattoo shop owner
item.description: Kenneth Wayne Brown Jr., 24, has been arrested and charged with capital murder for the Jan. 6 fatal shooting of Oak Cliff tattoo shop owner Just Smith-Gibbs.

item.title: Man charged with capital murder in double stabbing near Deep Ellum
item.description: A 27-year-old man faces capital murder charges after a double stabbing during a fight early Saturday morning near downtown Dallas.

item.title: Four North Dallas residents escape 2-alarm house fire, firefighter injured
item.description: A firefighter was injured Sunday morning while battling a two-alarm fire that caused significant damage to a home in North Dallas, fire officials said.

item.title: Coroner identifies three family members killed in Weatherford house fire
item.description: Authorities identified three family members killed, a grandmother, daughter-in-law, and granddaughter, following a fast-moving house fire in Parker County on Jan. 31.

item.title: Denton man charged with indecent exposure at University of North Texas
item.description: A 27-year-old man was arrested after allegedly entering women's locker rooms and restrooms at a Denton gym and the University of North Texas campus.

item.title: Dallas child who lost leg in New Year’s Day crash returns home
item.description: An 8-year-old boy returned home Friday to begin rehabilitation after losing his leg in a New Year’s Day crash caused by a suspected drunk driver on Central Expressway.
